A '''city''' served as the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Qlothos]].<ref name="Journal11">{{JournalCite|11|The Longest Fall}}</ref> By [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="3 ABY">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of {{JournalCite|2|The Longest Fall}} to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].</ref> a prominent [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] [[Unidentified Kuat Drive Yards engineer|engineer]] was on holiday at the capital with his family. While on the planet, the [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] and his family were inadvertently [[Death/Legends|killed]] during a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Attack on Qlothos|attack]].<ref name="Journal11" />
